stories.title: AI stocks lift Wall Street

stories.title: AI stocks drive market recovery
stories.summary: The S&P 500 rose 1.3 percent Wednesday, nearing a full recovery from last week's sell-off. The Nasdaq rallied 1.6 percent, while the Dow added 0.5 percent. The rebound was led by AI-related businesses, which had previously triggered market concerns about a potential industry slowdown.

stories.title: Yes Bank bondholders seek compliance
stories.summary: Axis Trustee Services Ltd has moved the Supreme Court after Yes Bank failed to provide a roadmap for restoring 84 billion rupees in AT-1 bonds. The Supreme Court recently upheld a ruling that set aside the bank's 2020 write-off. The bank did not respond to requests for comment.

stories.title: RBI updates domestic money transfer rules
stories.summary: The RBI has consolidated its domestic money transfer directions, allowing banks to provide cash pay-out and pay-in services through ATMs and agents. The new framework aims to formalise instructions for banks and non-banks, which may now fix reasonable charges for these services to popularise the platform.

stories.title: RBI consolidates money transfer framework
stories.summary: The RBI has consolidated its domestic money transfer rules into a single set of directions. The framework retains existing transaction limits and mandates additional authentication for cash-based remittances. Walk-in customers at bank branches can now transfer up to 50,000 rupees in cash to bank accounts.

stories.title: RBI consolidates money transfer rules
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: RBI sets new domestic money transfer limits
stories.summary: The RBI has consolidated its domestic money transfer rules, capping cash pay-out transfers at 10,000 rupees per transaction and 25,000 rupees per beneficiary monthly. Cash pay-in services are limited to 5,000 rupees per transaction. Banks must now strengthen monitoring of unusual fund transfers and mandate additional sender authentication.

stories.title: SEBI updates intermediary reporting requirements
stories.summary: SEBI has directed market intermediaries to update their KYC and tax-reporting systems to align with the Income-tax Rules of 2026. Intermediaries must now incorporate automatic exchange of information reporting and due diligence requirements into their customer onboarding frameworks to ensure compliance with international financial account standards.

stories.title: HDFC Bank raises lending rates
stories.summary: HDFC Bank has increased its marginal cost of funds-based lending rates by 5 to 15 basis points across all tenures. The new rates range from 7.85 percent to 8.70 percent. The hike follows the RBI's decision to raise the policy repo rate to 5.50 percent in October.

stories.title: Kashmir industry body questions RBI
stories.summary: The Federation of Chambers of Industries Kashmir has questioned the RBI over the lack of relief for distressed MSMEs. Despite repeated meetings on credit guarantees and revival, the body claims industrial units remain in crisis. It has demanded a public account of all implemented rehabilitation measures.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks cyber fraud measures
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed WhatsApp and other intermediaries to present measures for preventing cyber fraud. The court emphasised that banks must compensate victims for due diligence lapses. The RBI is expected to present new KYC rules to the court before the next hearing on November 23.

stories.title: NPCI explores AI agent payments
stories.summary: The NPCI is developing a registry to monitor AI agents that make payments on behalf of users. The goal is to allow AI assistants to execute transactions within set limits without human intervention. The challenge remains determining how much payment friction can be safely removed for automated agents.

stories.title: UPI expands global reach
stories.summary: The Unified Payments Interface is now accepted in 11 countries, with Greece and the Maldives being the latest to adopt the platform. Developed by the NPCI, the system aims to create a simple and secure digital payment ecosystem accessible to every citizen.

stories.title: Government says UPI will remain free for consumers
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry has clarified that UPI will remain free for consumers, with most merchant transactions also staying free of charge. Any future Merchant Discount Rate charges would apply only to a limited set of transactions above a certain threshold. Sustainability is the stated goal.

stories.title: Lumepay raises $6 million for African payments network
stories.summary: Cape Town fintech startup Lumepay has raised $6 million to build an African payments network. The company also secured $10 million in capital float to support client liquidity. Lumepay launched its cross-border platform in June 2026 to help businesses move money between African markets and international partners.

stories.title: Pine Labs eyes revenue boost from UPI merchant fees
stories.summary: Pine Labs expects a 0.4% merchant discount rate on UPI transactions above Rs 2,000 to unlock up to Rs 230 crore in annual revenue. The company plans to deploy 10 lakh soundboxes to capture merchant payments. It previously ignored some large merchant UPI transactions.

stories.title: UPI transaction volume hits 916 million on Diwali
stories.summary: UPI recorded 916.9 million transactions on Diwali, a 32% increase from last year. While transaction volume rose, the total value reached Rs 90,029 crore, a modest increase from the previous year. The growth was driven more by the number of payments than the total amount spent.

stories.title: Diwali shopping drives 32% jump in UPI volume
stories.summary: UPI transaction volume increased by 32% this Diwali compared to the same day last year, reaching 916.9 million transactions. The surge was attributed to last-minute festival shopping, food orders, and travel. Digital payments remain a fixture of daily life, even during traditional cash-heavy holidays.

stories.title: WasabiCard launches local issuing in 100 markets
stories.summary: WasabiCard, a provider of stablecoin-powered payments infrastructure, has announced the launch of its Local Issuing Solution. The company says the service will operate across more than 100 markets. Full details on the rollout are available for subscribers.

stories.title: NPCI silent on new date for UPI merchant fees
stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has yet to announce a date for implementing the Merchant Discount Rate on UPI transactions. The NPCI previously said a date would be announced immediately after Diwali. A spokesperson stated there is no announcement on this at the moment.

stories.title: Tide to invest Rs 3,100 crore in India by 2030
stories.summary: UK-based business financial platform Tide plans to invest Rs 3,100 crore in India by the end of 2030. The funding will scale operations and technology centres supporting its global business. The company may eventually ramp up its total investment to 500 million pounds.

stories.title: Retail investors maintain steady SIP pace in October
stories.summary: Retail investors continued to invest in mutual funds during October, with gross monthly SIP flows reaching Rs 32,160 crore. This figure remains near the all-time high of Rs 32,490 crore recorded in September. Investors showed a preference for large and mid-cap schemes over small-cap funds.

stories.title: Equity mutual fund inflows decline 14 percent
stories.summary: Equity mutual fund inflows fell to Rs 32,994 crore in October from Rs 38,307 crore in September. The moderation occurred as foreign institutional investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities. Large and mid-cap schemes remained the primary beneficiaries of fresh retail allocations.

stories.title: Post office time deposits offer four tenure options
stories.summary: The government offers post office time deposit schemes with tenures of one, two, three and five years. Similar to bank fixed deposits, these schemes require a one-time investment with the principal and interest paid at maturity. They are marketed as a safe option for risk-averse investors.

stories.title: Government keeps small savings interest rates steady
stories.summary: The government has maintained interest rates on small savings schemes for the October-December 2026 quarter. Investors often compare these government-backed options with bank fixed deposits to evaluate returns, liquidity, and tax benefits. Both categories offer varying conditions for different investment periods.

stories.title: Bank fixed deposits may auto-renew at lower rates
stories.summary: Banks typically send maturity reminders, but fixed deposits may auto-renew at current interest rates if proceeds are not claimed. Depositors who overlook these notifications might find their funds locked into a lower-yielding term. The accumulated corpus remains intact, but the interest rate is subject to change.

stories.title: Compounding potential of monthly SIPs highlighted
stories.summary: A monthly SIP of Rs 5,000 could grow to over Rs 1.76 crore over 30 years, assuming a 12% annual return. Systematic investment plans allow investors to contribute fixed amounts at regular intervals. The primary advantage cited for this strategy is the long-term power of compounding.

stories.title: Small and mid-cap mutual fund inflows ease
stories.summary: Small-cap fund inflows fell 29% and mid-cap inflows dropped 38% in October. Conversely, large-cap funds saw a 20% increase in inflows to Rs 1,032 crore. Total equity mutual fund inflows declined 14% month-on-month as investors moved away from record-high allocations in smaller segments.

stories.title: SIP stoppage ratio reaches 116 percent in October
stories.summary: More investors discontinued their systematic investment plans than registered new ones in October, resulting in a 116% stoppage ratio. This is the highest level since April 2025. During the month, 5.9 million SIPs were stopped or completed while 5.1 million new ones were registered.

stories.title: Small-cap mutual fund inflows moderate in October
stories.summary: Small-cap mutual fund inflows fell 29% to Rs 6,407 crore in October. Analysts described the decline from September's Rs 9,039 crore as a healthy moderation rather than an alarming trend. Some experts suggest the shift reflects growing investor caution toward the small-cap segment.

stories.title: Financial experts suggest post-Diwali budget review
stories.summary: Financial experts are advising households to review bank statements and credit card bills following the Diwali festive season. Suggestions for rebuilding finances include assessing debt and categorizing expenses. The goal is to enter 2027 with a clearer understanding of spending and savings patterns.

stories.title: Equity mutual fund inflows fall 14 percent in October
stories.summary: Equity mutual fund investments contracted nearly 14 percent to reach 32,994 crore rupees in October, while SIP inflows shrunk about 1 percent, according to AMFI. Total assets under management for equity funds stood at 37.14 lakh crore rupees. Volatility is the official explanation for the decline.

stories.title: SIP stoppage ratio climbs to 116 percent
stories.summary: The SIP stoppage ratio rose to 115.7 percent in October, as 59 lakh accounts were discontinued or matured against 51 lakh new registrations. Monthly contributions remained at 32,162 crore rupees, slightly below the September record. For every new plan added, more than one left the building.
